journey: Enterprise SSO/SAML: fabric consumes resolved tenant PAT; identity layer owner-gated

narrative.step: a RESOLVED tenant PAT (however the user authenticated) is accepted by the /v1 surface
narrative.assertion: authed GET /v1/usage → 200 for tenant=00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000f0004 — the fabric only consumes PAT verification + tenancy (auth method is upstream)

narrative.step: there is NO fabric login to SSO-enable — a missing PAT → 401 unauthorized (identity is consumed, not owned)
narrative.assertion: no PAT → 401 code=unauthorized (the fabric has no user base; identity is CoreLink/Clerk's)

narrative.step: records the SSO residual — SAML/SCIM live in the identity layer, owner-gated
narrative.assertion: the org→tenant mapping resolving a PAT the /v1 surface accepts is the fabric's whole obligation; SSO/SAML/SCIM are not here

artifact.sso: owner-gated (ADR-0002 identity — HuGR account / Clerk pool; SAML/SCIM = identity layer, not in repo; gated on CoreLink self-serve GA M2)
